task_description: Final natural-language electron-event checkpoint smoke. First repeats the fixed valid256 one-decision gold-state diagnostic. Then evaluates 32 fixed >=3-event validation reactions at H=1, H=2, H=3, and full electron-event suffixes. A trusted prefix and oracle exogenous fragment schedule are used; after the branch point there is no gold state feedback. K=1 greedy. This is a controlled error-accumulation diagnostic, not product-only endpoint accuracy.
